stories.title: Did Michigan deserve that last second? We welcome college football back with all the absurdity it brings
stories.summary: CFB Week 1 takeaways: Michigan gets a gift, LSU looks title-ready, and UMass wins!

stories.title: U-M wins on controversial finish; B1G backs review
stories.summary: Michigan got a second chance at a Hail Mary and connected in a 13-12 stunner over Western Michigan on Saturday, after which the Big Ten confirmed that officials correctly added time back on the clock to give the Wolverines another shot.

stories.title: Drama, delay doesn't dampen Kiffin's LSU debut
stories.summary: Arizona State transfer quarterback Sam Leavitt and Wisconsin transfer running back Dilin Jones combined for four rushing touchdowns in their new uniforms, and LSU ended a week of off-the-field drama with an easy 51-10 victory over Clemson on Saturday.

stories.title: Infantino sticking to reelection bid amid backlash
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has reiterated his desire to stand for re-election despite the continuing controversy surrounding his leadership.

stories.title: Vikes' Smith agrees to deal, back for 15th season
stories.summary: Vikings safety Harrison Smith is returning for a 15th season, with sources telling NFL Network he reached a one-year deal worth $12.25 million.
